c1.note: Q3 2026 gross profit was $176M on revenue of $2,155M, about 8%.

c2.note: $176M minus $24M in Q3 2025 equals the $152M improvement.

c3.note: Q3 revenue was $2.155B, up 38% year over year.

c4.note: Q1 2026 gross profit was $119M on $1,381M revenue, about 9%. It is dated April 30, outside the 90-day window.

c5.note: Q2 2026 gross profit was $179M. It is dated July 30, outside the 90-day window.

c6.note: Q4 2025 gross profit was $120M per the quarterly table.

c7.note: Q1 ($119M), Q2 ($179M) and Q3 ($176M) 2026 were all positive, so Q3 is the third in a row.

c8.note: Gross profit was $120M, $119M, $179M and $176M from Q4 2025 through Q3 2026, all positive.

c9.note: Rivian states R2 was its best-selling vehicle by volume, outselling R1 and EDV, in Q3.

c10.note: The release says R2 delivered much of the quarter-over-quarter gain.

c11.note: Record deliveries of 19,248 units in Q3 2026.

c12.note: Deliveries were up 46% year over year (19,248 vs 13,201).

c13.note: Production of 19,751 was a record for Normal, per the release.

c14.note: The presentation says a second R2 production shift started in Normal during Q3.

c15.note: The slide says automotive COGS per unit improved by over $12,000 quarter over quarter on higher R2 mix and fixed-cost leverage.

c16.note: The $12,000 per-unit COGS improvement was Q3 vs Q2 (quarter-over-quarter), not a step-down in Q2 2026; the Fool summary's wording is garbled.

c20.note: Rivian states a 50% BOM cost reduction versus R1 from the electrical architecture redesign and simpler manufacturing, which is a design claim. The May 27 date is not confirmed.

c22.note: The Q3 call said R2 should help achieve a positive Automotive gross margin exit rate for the year.

c24.note: The call said the exit rate would establish a strong foundation for continued margin expansion as R2 ramps through 2027.

c26.note: Mulvey said the intent is to exit the quarter at an automotive gross profit and that he would not expect the full quarter to be positive.

c27.note: The 10-Q and press release state about $120M of incremental Q3 cost of revenues from the R2 ramp versus normalized production.

c28.note: The 10-Q gives $120M for Q3 and $220M for the nine months, which implies about $100M in the prior quarters (Q2 mainly, since R2 began in June).

c30.note: Arithmetic: -80 + 120 = +40, an implied figure that ignores credits and the tariff refund, and the claim labels it as implied.

c31.note: The Q3 release raised the delivery range from 65-70k to 67-70k. The floor moved, not the top.

c32.note: The Q2 release shows the prior outlook was 65,000-70,000.

c33.note: Adjusted EBITDA improved $100M and capex fell $300M, both at the midpoint. The EBITDA gain was partly regulatory credits and a tariff refund.

c34.note: The 10-K gives installed capacity of up to 155,000 R2 vehicles a year at Normal.

c35.note: The 10-K says Normal can produce up to 215,000 vehicles a year, and the Q3 10-Q repeats the 215,000 figure.

c36.note: Confirmed: Georgia Phase 1 upsized 50% to 300k units, production late 2028, DOE loan up to $4.5B. The 2024 conditional commitment and Sept 2025 groundbreaking dates were not in the passages.

c37.note: The Q2 release says 'On June 9, Rivian began external deliveries of R2'.

c38.note: Performance with Launch Package starts at $57,990 before taxes and fees, in both the March and June releases.

c41.note: R2 Premium is due late 2026, starting at $53,990.

c42.note: The June release says Standard RWD Long Range at $48,490 begins in early 2027. The March release said first half of 2027.

c43.note: The March 12 release says Standard from $48,490 is available in the first half of 2027.

c44.note: The June release puts the $44,990 Standard version in summer 2027. The March release had said late 2027 at about $45,000.
